interpretation.low_rank_rejection: Even the best rank-16 approximation to the summed routed write, an optimistic ceiling for eight rank-2 experts at 200x, recovers only 0.454 on average and 0.359 in the worst layer/bank. Both preregistered gates fail by a wide margin.
interpretation.honest_state_scale: An even per-expert allocation of the joint directions needed for 80% function corresponds to only about 22.5--46.8x c_proj compression; 90% corresponds to about 12.7--21.6x. These are descriptive ordinary-low-rank scales, not universal nonlinear-generator lower bounds.
interpretation.frame_stability: The leading output subspaces are stable across independent token banks: mean canonical-overlap scores remain about 0.78--0.91 from rank 1 through rank 64. The missing capacity is therefore a wide persistent residual-output frame, not mainly transient token-frame noise.
interpretation.combined_with_mpo: The low-rank ceiling does not apply to the full-ordinary-rank rank-nine MPO. Its independent failure at about 0.358 recovery shows that merely hiding full rank inside 4,194 tensor coordinates does not solve the orientation/state problem.
interpretation.next_architecture_class: Test whether the stable wide residual-output frame can be amortized across experts and layers. A shared residual-space basis plus compact per-matrix coefficient generation is the only causally supported compact class; another per-matrix rank/tensor/FHT sweep is not. Cross-layer/expert shareability must pass a zero-update heldout oracle before implementation or training.

scope_caveat: This is an optimistic necessary condition for explicit ordinary-low-rank expert matrices with fixed terminal routing and c_fc. It is not an information-theoretic lower bound for all nonlinear procedural generators; isolated-expert spectra are descriptive because joint function may permit cancellation.
